samples.question: Each card contains four colored horizontal intervals, one per row. Rows may be rearranged, and a whole card may be shifted or stretched horizontally. Read all eight interval endpoints from left to right, recording both color and whether each endpoint starts or ends its interval. Which colored border encloses the option with exactly the same endpoint order as the REFERENCE? Answer red, blue, or gold.
